name: fine-pencil
lock:
Create one isolated fine hand-drawn raster object illustration for {context}. Square 1:1 canvas, fully transparent background, no surrounding card, no border, no shadow, no lettering, no labels, no watermark, no UI screenshot. The object occupies about 78% of canvas width and 72% of height with balanced clear margins. Premium hard-pencil and technical-pen drawing: warm dark grey ink close to {ink}, restrained irregular contours, delicate parallel hatching, subtle light neutral paper interiors. One SMALL but clearly saturated {accent_name} {accent} mark, no other colors, no large {accent_name} fills. Draw with economy and clear silhouette readable when resized to {min_size}; no hairline clutter. Neither glossy nor flat vector; no emoji, no 3D render, no beige vintage paper. {set_rule} must feel like the same illustrator, same line weight and same amount of ink.

Bold readable outline, at most three elements, thicker contour than fine hatching; must stay recognizable at {min_size}.
brief: Brief: Draw {subject} as the single main object, simple friendly proportions; the only {accent_name} is {accent_part}. Keep interiors near-white with only a little edge hatching.
